question: How do I check my subscription status and character usage via the API?
ground_truth: Call the GET /v1/user endpoint to retrieve your subscription information. The response includes a subscription object containing: tier (string), character_count (integer - current usage), character_limit (integer - maximum allowed), voice_slots_used (integer), voice_limit (integer), status (enum: trialing, active, incomplete, past_due, free, free_disabled), currency (enum: usd, eur, inr or null), billing_period (monthly_period, annual_period, or null), and capability flags like can_use_instant_voice_cloning and can_use_professional_voice_cloning (booleans). For extended subscription details, you can also use the GET /v1/user/subscription endpoint.
